text:
Compound Z has the molecular formula C2H6O.
Which statement about compound Z is correct?
A
Z is unsaturated.
B
Z is a carboxylic acid.
C
Z is formed by the reaction of ethane with steam.
D
Z is used as a fuel.

options.label: C
options.text: Z is formed by the reaction of ethane with steam.

options.label: D
options.text: Z is used as a fuel.
